name: com.mediaway.unity
description: Rust-based, lightweight, fast — Unity-specific glue (Texture2D/AudioClip conversion) over the Mediaway.Device.Camera/Mediaway.Device.Audio/Mediaway.Pipeline netstandard2.0 C# bindings. Does not itself contain the Mediaway bindings — restore Mediaway.Common/Mediaway.Device/Mediaway.Device.Camera/Mediaway.Device.Audio/Mediaway.Pipeline into the project via NuGetForUnity first.

samples.description: Opens the default camera and displays polled frames on a RawImage via MediawayTextureConverter.
